candidates.description: This vector activates for dependent vowel signs in Indic scripts alongside unrelated ASCII character fragments due to shared byte-level representations.
This feature vector represents common Hindi vowel signs and consonant-vowel combinations used in word formation.
This vector is related to character n-grams and common syllables found in the Hindi language written in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector represents character sequences and conjunct consonants from the Devanagari script used for Indic languages.
This feature vector activates on common Hindi verb roots, suffixes, and inflectional morphemes.
This feature vector activates strongly on characters, subwords, and words from the Hindi writing system (Devanagari script).
This vector detects fragmented or non-English script subwords, often representing encoding artifacts or rare characters from diverse writing systems.
This vector activates common Hindi function words, pronouns, and quantifiers.
This feature vector activates on tokens and sub-word units containing common South Asian and Middle Eastern script fragments, particularly in Hindi and Arabic-Persian-Urdu orthographies.
This vector activates for the Hindi consonant 'भ' (bha) and its various vowel and conjunct variations.
